test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

The small coffee shop at the end of the road is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The small coffee shop at the end of the road is being referred to as something belonging to the** speaker,** which is why '**mine' **is the appropriate **possessive** **pronoun.**
 
• Using '**mine' **correctly indicates ownership by the speaker without needing to repeat the noun '**coffee shop'.**
 
• Other options like** 'their', 'my', or 'our' do not **fit grammatically in this context. As these are object pronoun and possessive adjective.

Hence, the correct statement is '***The small coffee shop at the end of the road is mine*.'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Possessive pronouns **are used to show ownership and do not require an additional noun after them.
 
• Common possessive pronouns include: **mine, yours, his, hers, ours, theirs.**
 
• Example:
 
 
• *This book is** mine.***
 
• *Is this pen** yours?***
